spark.scene: True-color satellite view of the Hawaiian Islands from Kauai in the northwest to Hawaii Island in the southeast, with scattered white cumulus and cirrus clouds over ocean and around islands and a larger cloud deck in the southwest, dark open ocean elsewhere, no distinct haze, smoke or volcanic plume clearly separable from ordinary clouds.

kilauea.activity_summary: Kīlauea volcano is not erupting; the summit eruption in Halemaʻumaʻu is paused. After a period of instability, the summit has reinflated more steadily over the past two days. More data are needed to model the forecast window for the next episode.

mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in July, while the summit region showed patterns of slight inflation. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 57 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the July reporting period, after 94 in June. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
